'''Vestig''' was an [[Aide/Legends|aide]] for the [[Imperial Advisor/Legends|Imperial Advisor]] [[Coh Veshiv]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]<ref name="Orbit" /> in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].<ref name="Date">{{FarOrbitDate}}</ref> At that [[Time/Legends|time]], Veshiv was on an inspection tour of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]] on the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[Empire Forever]]''. While Veshiv was at Esseles, the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] ''[[Far Orbit]]''{{'s}} [[Captain/Legends|captain]], [[Dhas Fenoep Vedij]], volunteered to take Veshiv on the next part of his journey, so Vestig, along with fellow [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]] [[Pich]], accompanied Veshiv over to the ''Far Orbit'' in the [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] ''[[Myrenia]]''. However, it turned out that the ''Far Orbit'' was really an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Privateer/Legends|privateering]] vessel, and Veshiv was [[Capture of Coh Veshiv|captured]] by the crew of the ''Far Orbit''.<ref name="Orbit" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vestig appears in the adventure scenario ''[[The Capture of Coh Veshiv]]'' from [[1998]]'s ''[[The Far Orbit Project]]'', a book by [[Timothy S. O'Brien]] as a supplement to [[West End Games]]'s ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Orbit" />
